direction: Simple realistic photographs without people, with natural daylight and green/grey work objects.
encoding: JPEG quality 88, original dimensions and composition preserved

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Style/medium: exceptionally believable natural editorial still-life photography, a matched photographic series of ordinary physical objects, simple uncluttered compositions. Soft natural window daylight, normal neutral white balance, no green color filter. Real paper, fabric, paint, and metal textures with slight everyday imperfections; accurate physical construction and perspective. Colors are physical accents of woodland green #2C3628, deeper green #181E12, olive #6C733D, muted green #4B5745, and soft greys #D7D7D9 / #F0F0F2.
Constraints: no people, faces, portraits, hands, human reflections, illustrations, CGI or plastic rendering, logos, watermarks, legible text, interface overlays, decorative frames, or image grids. Looks like an actual editorial photograph.
Asset type: Remote Hustle website accordion overview image.
Primary request: an inviting modest clean unoccupied workstation beside a window: a simple light grey desk, an empty dark woodland-green chair, a slim closed silver laptop and exactly one olive notebook. Quiet light grey wall. No other desk accessories. Focus on the ordinary desk and empty chair in the middle/lower part, uncluttered. Real matte paint and chair fabric, natural contact shadows.
Composition/framing: one portrait photograph, exactly 3:4 aspect ratio. Keep the main subject near the middle/lower-middle, with the top and left visually quiet for HTML text overlay. Generous crop margins so the subjects remain recognizable in narrow accordion cards and mobile crops. Objects must be substantial enough to recognize after cropping.
assets.inspection: Pass: empty workstation with grey desk, dark green fabric chair, closed silver laptop and olive notebook. Natural window daylight, realistic materials, ample quiet upper wall, no people or hands.
